Wir isentos verstehen uns als Team. Uns ist es wichtig, dass wir uns jederzeit aufeinander verlassen können - fachlich genauso wie persönlich. Wir unterstützen uns gegenseitig und helfen einander, denn nur so erreichen wir unser gemeinsames Ziel: die beste Lösung für unsere Kunden abzuliefern.

Who You’ll Work With Arista Networks is looking for world-class software engineers to join our Software for Open Networking in the Cloud (SONiC) software development team. As a core member of the SONiC team, you will be part of a fast-paced, high caliber team building and qualifying features to run the world's largest data center networks.

The SONiC team is responsible for all aspects of the development and delivery of SONiC software meant to run on various Arista switches. You will work with your fellow engineers and members of the marketing team to gather and understand the functional and technical requirements for upcoming projects.

You will help write functional specifications, design specifications, test plans, and the code to bring all of these to life and work with the SONiC community to upstream the code/test changes. You will also work with customers to triage and fix problems in their networks.

Internally, you will develop automated tests for your software, monitor the execution of those tests, and triage and fix problems found by your tests. At Arista, you will own your projects from definition to deployment, and you will be responsible for the quality of everything you deliver.

What You’ll Do This role demands strong and broad software engineering fundamentals, and ideally a good understanding of networking including capabilities like L2, L3, and fundamentals of commercial switching HW. Responsibilities: Write functional specifications and design specifications for system software to manage hardware components.

Independently implement solutions to small-sized problems in the system software using the C, C++, and python programming languages. Write test plan specifications for small-sized features and implement automated test programs to execute the cases described in the test plan. Debug problems found by our automated test programs and fix the problems.

Work on a team implementing, testing, and debugging solutions to larger routing protocol problems. Worth with Customer Support Engineers to analyze problems in customer networks and provide fixes for those problems when needed in the form of new software releases or software patches.

Work with the System Test Engineers to analyze problems found in their tests and provide fixes for those problems. Mentor new and junior engineers to bring them up to speed in Arista’s software development environment as well as broader SONiC development.

Review and contribute to the specifications and implementations written by other team members and the SONiC community. Help to create a schedule for the implementation and debugging tasks, update that schedule weekly, and report it to the project lead.

BSc, MS or Ph.D. in Computer Science/Electrical Engineering/Computer Engineering with 2+ years of related post graduate work experience Knowledge of C, C++, and/or python. Knowledge of UNIX or Linux.

Understanding of L2/L3 networking including at least one of the following areas is desirable: IP routing protocols, such as RIP, OSPF, BGP, IS-IS, or PIM. Layer 2 features such as 802.1d bridging, the 802.1d Spanning Tree Protocol, the 802.1ax Link Aggregation Control Protocol, the 802.1AB Link Layer Discovery Protocol, or RFC 1812 IP routing.

Ability to utilize, test, and debug packet forwarding engine and a hardware component’s vendor provided software libraries in your solutions. Infrastructure functions related to distributed systems such as messaging, signaling, databases, and command line interface techniques.

Hands-on experience in the design and development of ethernet bridging or routing related software or distributed systems software is desirable.

Hands-on experience with enterprise or service provider class Ethernet switch/router system software development, or significant PhD level research in the area of network routing and packet forwarding is desirable. Applied understanding of software engineering principles. Strong problem solving and software troubleshooting skills.

Ability to design a solution to a small-sized problem, and implement that solution without outside help.

Analiza y porta el Test OS (usado para pruebas, diagnósticos y validación) de vehículos Gen2 a Gen1, adaptando su arquitectura, servicios y flujo de despliegue.
Desarrolla capas de abstracción de software para garantizar la compatibilidad entre el Test OS y el hardware de las ECUs.
Integra funcionalidades clave como diagnósticos (UDS, DoIP), flasheo de firmware, adquisición de datos (logging) y monitoreo de salud en tiempo real.

Depura problemas entre capas (software, hardware, comunicación) y colabora con equipos multidisciplinarios para cerrar brechas de plataforma.

Su trabajo asegura que los sistemas embebidos en vehículos Gen1 funcionen con la misma robustez y capacidad de prueba que los de Gen2, garantizando calidad, seguridad y cumplimiento de estándares automotrices (ej: ASPICE, MISRA C).

**Le Centre national suisse de superinformatique (CSCS)** développe et exploite une infrastructure de recherche en calcul haute performance et données qui soutient une science de classe mondiale en Suisse. Le centre est exploité par l-ETH Zurich et dispose de bureaux dans son centre de données à Lugano et à Zurich.
## Contexte du projet ##

**OpenCHAMI** signifie **Open Composable Heterogeneous Adaptable Management Infrastructure**. Il s-agit d-un projet open source qui fournit des outils modernes de gestion et de provisionnement des systèmes pour les clusters et superordinateurs de **calcul haute performance (HPC)**. Le projet, avec un financement limité et donc une durée de contrat limitée, vise à apporter des capacités de déploiement, d-automatisation et de sécurité similaires à celles du cloud aux environnements HPC.
Ce projet, avec lieu de travail à Lugano ou Zurich, se concentre sur le développement et l-avancement d-OpenCHAMI pour l-infrastructure de superinformatique de nouvelle génération du CSCS. Le travail contribuera à construire une approche ouverte, évolutive et moderne de la gestion des clusters pour les systèmes HPC à grande échelle.
L-objectif principal est de concevoir, développer, intégrer et déployer les capacités d-OpenCHAMI adaptées aux exigences opérationnelles des superordinateurs du CSCS.
Le projet abordera les défis liés à la gestion de systèmes HPC et IA de plus en plus complexes et contribuera à l-évolution des technologies open source de gestion de clusters de nouvelle génération.

Nous valorisons l-excellence technique, la curiosité, l-initiative et la capacité d-apprendre et de grandir plus qu-une liste parfaite de compétences. Travailler sur l-infrastructure HPC de nouvelle génération nécessite une volonté d-explorer de nouvelles technologies, de résoudre des problèmes complexes et de développer continuellement de nouvelles expertises.
Si vous êtes motivé à avoir un impact significatif dans ce domaine mais ne remplissez pas tous les critères, nous vous encourageons vivement à postuler.

Nous proposons un contrat initial de deux ans offrant la possibilité de travailler à la pointe de l-infrastructure HPC et IA au CSCS, contribuant directement au développement de technologies qui soutiendront les futurs systèmes de superinformatique.
Vous aurez l-opportunité de contribuer à OpenCHAMI et aux initiatives open source associées, en collaborant avec la communauté HPC au sens large et en participant à des programmes à fort impact aux niveaux national et international, notamment HPSF, OpenCHAMI et initiatives connexes.

You'll join the team that owns our real\-time media stack, including native clients, the web browser and our SFU infrastructure. * Build and improve the WebRTC media pipeline across web, desktop and mobile clients, including audio, video, screen sharing and data channels.
* Develop and scale our Selective Forwarding Unit (SFU) and signaling services to support large meetings, webinars and breakout rooms.
* Tune congestion control, bandwidth estimation, simulcast and SVC layer selection so calls adapt gracefully to poor networks.
* Own call quality end to end: define metrics, build dashboards, investigate issues using getStats, RTC event logs and packet traces, and ship fixes.
* Work on NAT traversal and connectivity, including STUN/TURN infrastructure, ICE behavior and fallbacks for restrictive corporate networks.
* Collaborate with client, backend, security and product teams on features like recording, live captions, noise suppression and end\-to\-end encryption.
* Review code, mentor other engineers and help set technical direction for the real\-time stack.

* 5\+ years of software engineering experience, with at least 3 years working directly on WebRTC or other real\-time media systems.
* Deep understanding of the WebRTC stack: SDP, ICE, DTLS, SRTP, and how they fit together in practice.
* Experience building or operating an SFU or MCU, whether custom or based on open\-source projects such as mediasoup, Janus, Jitsi, Pion or LiveKit.
* Solid knowledge of audio and video codecs (Opus, VP8, VP9, AV1, and their trade\-offs.
* Strong skills in at least one of C\+\+, Kotlin, Go or Rust, plus comfort with TypeScript/JavaScript for browser\-side work.
* A methodical approach to debugging distributed, latency\-sensitive systems where the root cause might be the network, the device or the code.
* Clear communication and the ability to explain complex media problems to people outside the team.

* Contributions to libwebrtc or open\-source WebRTC projects.
* Experience with Insertable Streams / SFrame for end\-to\-end encrypted media.
* Background in audio processing (echo cancellation, noise suppression, AGC) or ML\-based media enhancement.
